en.t: The woman was still sleeping very soundly.

units.source_text: 大概在做梦吧，手脚扑扑地轻轻颤动。

en.t: She was probably dreaming; her hands and feet were twitching lightly.

units.source_text: 刚才盘算着要去捣乱她的睡眠，到现在还未开始。

en.t: He had been planning just now to disturb her sleep, but even now he had not begun.

units.source_text: 连他自己，也已经睡得足足的了。

en.t: Even he himself had already slept more than enough.
